description: This file contains extension methods for lifecycle participants in the Orleans framework, enabling components to participate in lifecycle events and adapt between different lifecycle participant types.

classes.name: Bridge<TLifecycle>
classes.description: A private inner class that adapts a lifecycle participant of ILifecycleObservable to a participant of another lifecycle observer type.

methods.name: ParticipateIn
methods.description: Extension method that wraps an ILifecycleParticipant of ILifecycleObservable to participate in a specific lifecycle, returning an ILifecycleParticipant of the targeted lifecycle type.
